messages:
Maya: Quick poll — for the Friday game night, are people leaning Split Pad Pro (portable comfort) or Pro Grip (full-hand comfort)? Also asking because I need to lock the pizza order count.
Sam: Split Pad Pro for me :raised_hands: easier to bring to the couch.
Jordan: Pro Grip — my hands cramp on long sessions unless I have decent grips.
Lee: Split Pad here but I might bring my Switch + dock just in case.
Priya: Pro Grip + pineapple pizza option pls :pizza: (I will pay extra).
Maya: Noted. Rough headcount: who’s coming in person?
Sam: Me +1 (bringing ethernet cable and a spare USB-C hub).
Jordan: I’ll be remote for the first hour, then sliding in around 7:30.
Lee: In person. Can volunteer to manage the music queue if someone wants to DM me playlists.
Priya: In person, can carry 2 extra controllers and some AA batteries.
Maya: ops-bot, create a quick reaction poll for Split Pad / Pro Grip / no preference?
ops-bot: Poll created — React with :one: SplitPad, :two: ProGrip, :three: No preference. Poll will close in 2 hours.
Sam: FWIW, if we need adapters, I have a Switch Pro controller + 8bitdo receiver.
Jordan: If anyone wants to borrow my Steam keys, I can add a small rotation list — ping me.
Lee: Can someone confirm pizza dietary needs? I can add a vegan pie if needed.
Priya: Vegan please 🙂 and gluten-free slice for Jordan? (jk on GF but actually I can do one).
Maya: Cool — tally so far: SplitPad 1, ProGrip 2, No pref 0. Pizza: 2 regular, 1 vegan. Anyone else joining? Tag me so I can finalize order by 3pm.
Sam: @Maya tagging Lewis from eng-sre — he said he might swing by.
Jordan: @Maya included me in the Steam-share rotation, cheers.
Lee: Also reminder — office couch space = limited. If we get >8 people might need floor setups or bring a projector.
Priya: I can bring a couple of folding cushions.
Maya: Sweet. Thanks y’all — will post final order + address in 30m. :thumbsup:
